reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Intensification of prevention, diagnostic and HIV comprehensive care amongst vulnerable populations in high burden prioritized municipalities - Guatemala (01-Oct-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Guatemala, HIV, Institute of Nutrition of Central America and Panama (INCAP) (INCAP)This program has the following goals: More availability of combined prevention interventions, adopting new approaches and using innovative strategies and technologies that have proven highly effective in preventing HIV transmission, with an emphasis on priority populations.. More availability of integrated care for STIs, HIV and AIDS, ensuring continuity and a focus on people, families and the community.. Promoting a favorable social, legal and regulatory environment that facilitates equitable access to health care, gender equality and the full exercising of human rights.. Strengthening the Ministry of Public Health and Social Welfare (MSPAS) and links with the various sectors involved in the national response to implement political, strategic, technical and administrative mechanisms that facilitate governance and sustainability of the national response to HIV and other STIs.. The objectives of this program are: Reduction in the transmission of HIV in priority populations.. Rapid referral of people living with HIV (PLHIV) to integrated health services for HIV.. Antiretroviral therapy (ART) for 90 percent of PLHIV.. Viral suppression in 90 percent of people undergoing ART.. Protection of the human rights of PLHIV and priority populations.. Strengthening MSPAS for routine reporting, the provision of high-quality integrated services and effective coordination with local authorities and leaders to ensure the sustainability of the national response to the HIV epidemic..
